rationale: src_cmd is a 2-bit atomic opcode whose two bits may change on one src_clk edge. Each bit gets its own two-stage synchroniser, so skew in metastability resolution can present an opcode that was never sent (01 to 10 can show as 00 or 11). There is no Gray or independent-field contract.
caveats: CDC-009 is the only defect-specific detector. Its trigger is written for a crossing group. CDC-007 and CDC-029 explicitly cover primary inputs, but CDC-009's text does not, apart from CDC-029's note about inputs without set_input_delay. If the predicate excludes delay-bound primary inputs, this case is a real miss, not an exclusion.
CDC-029 INFO (structurally synchronised) is not detection.

Raw rst_n asynchronously resets every register with no local release synchroniser and no SDC reset exception; RDC-003 (WARNING Unresolved), RDC-002 (WARNING Unresolved) and RDC-013 (physical obligation) are expected if RDC rules run. The contract states only asynchronous assertion, so this is a whole-IP premise gap, not a defect of the labelled crossing.

limitations: Structural attribution is a proposal for independent adjudication, not analyzer outcome.
Physical timing and metastability requirements remain external.

labels.rationale: An atomic opcode can change multiple bits; independent two-stage bit sampling can produce an opcode never sent.
Independent two-stage bit sampling cannot preserve an atomic opcode when multiple source bits change together.
labels.caveats: Raw rst_n release is not locally synchronized or bounded by a release contract; RDC-003 remains a whole-IP closure confounder. Output consumer timing is not specified. Physical closure is excluded.
